dog.description_text:
Meet Oliver Fish, a big cat with a big presence and an even bigger heart.

Oliver is a former diabetic currently in remission, and he’s doing well. Weight management is critical for Oliver. He has lost more than 6 pounds at ARF, and continued, gradual weight loss is one of the most important factors in helping him stay in remission. Obesity is a known risk factor for relapse, so his adopter must be committed to this goal and understand that diabetes can return.

Oliver is a survivor in every sense of the word and deserves a knowledgeable, dedicated home that will support his long-term health and celebrate his progress every step of the way. He enjoys all the attention he can get and can't wait to be your best friend who snuggles up on the couch with you every night.
